## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: weak sector breadth (≤4/11) and defensive/healthcare leadership (MDT, ABT, UNH, JNJ) outperforming; note major divergence among large-cap Tech names which suppresses aggressive risk-on posture. Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 contains 3 Healthcare names).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Healthcare leads: MDT (1W: +10.65% | 1M: +5.24%) ABOVE TREND, ABT (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +5.53%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +5.04% | 1M: +8.76%) ABOVE TREND. Energy next: MPC (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +7.01%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +3.21% | 1M: +1.51%) ABOVE TREND. Financials showing pockets of strength: WFC (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +2.47%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +5.22% | 1M: +3.82%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging: NVDA (1W: -2.75% | 1M: -1.20%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -7.46% | 1M: +0.87%) CORRECTION. Communication weak: GOOGL (1W: -3.11% | 1M: -7.41%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -6.25% | 1M: -3.24%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary under pressure with TSLA (1W: -10.28% | 1M: -1.94%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: MDT (1W: +10.65% | 1M: +5.24%) ABOVE TREND; DE (1W: +7.61% | 1M: -1.39%) RECOVERY; ABT (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +5.53%) ABOVE TREND; WFC (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +2.47%) ABOVE TREND; CVS (1W: +5.44% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Healthcare-heavy).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: AMD (1W: -9.63% | 1M: +10.68%) CORRECTION; HON (1W: -10.04% | 1M: -0.79%) BELOW TREND; TSLA (1W: -10.28% | 1M: -1.94%) BELOW TREND; INTU (1W: -10.49% | 1M: -23.62%) BELOW TREND; INTC (1W: -13.52% | 1M: -12.25%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in major Technology names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W movers: MDT (1W: +10.65% | 1M: +5.24%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +7.61% | 1M: -1.39%) RECOVERY, ABT (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +5.53%) ABOVE TREND; watch short-term momentum in banks WFC (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +2.47%) ABOVE TREND. Flag: Major divergence—several large caps (AAPL, MSFT, AMD, QCOM) show 1W vs 1M splits, indicating tactical volatility not confirmed broad participation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology is weak this week (1W: -6.02% | 1M: +5.89%) with many big caps in CORRECTION or BELOW TREND: AAPL (1W: -1.51% | 1M: +7.00%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -7.46% | 1M: +0.87%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: -2.75% | 1M: -1.20%) BELOW TREND. Sector shows short-term selling into longer-term gains → watch for follow-through or further mean reversion.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials mixed but constructive: WFC (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +2.47%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +5.22% | 1M: +3.82%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +4.36% | 1M: -0.80%) RECOVERY. Sector 1W positive but 1M flat to slightly negative; selective bank exposure favored while monitoring credit/earnings headlines.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare showing defensive leadership: MDT (1W: +10.65% | 1M: +5.24%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +5.04% | 1M: +8.76%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.30% | 1M: +4.22%) ABOVE TREND. Breadth supportive within sector and confirming the risk-off bias.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor defensive Healthcare names and selective Financials given current RISK-OFF posture; reduce exposure to large-cap Growth/Tech names showing trend exhaustion and headline sensitivity. Monitor short-term divergence in mega-caps—tactical opportunities may appear but confirmation is required before reallocating core risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: MDT (1W: +10.65% | 1M: +5.24%) ABOVE TREND, ABT (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +5.53%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +7.01%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -2.75% | 1M: -1.20%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: -9.09% | 1M: -10.53%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -10.49% | 1M: -23.62%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W: +2.04% | 1M: +4.25%) and Energy (1W: +2.83% | 1M: +2.90%). BEARISH: Technology (1W: -6.02% | 1M: +5.89%) and Communication (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -6.86%)—watch for continued flows away from high multiple growth.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch big-cap trend confirmation/breaks: NVDA sustain/break of this week’s lows would confirm continued BELOW TREND pressure; AAPL failing this week’s support keeps it in CORRECTION; JPM holding 1W highs would confirm RECOVERY momentum; MDT closing below this week’s gap would remove ABOVE TREND confirmation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
ABT (+55): Abbott headline on diabetes tech; ABT (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +5.53%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. PLTR (+60): Palantir partnership headline; PLTR (1W: -13.42% | 1M: +1.30%) CORRECTION — bullish news but price is diverging (distribution risk).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
INTU (-65): TurboTax probe headlines; INTU (1W: -10.49% | 1M: -23.62%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. AMD (-50): Competitive concerns vs Nvidia; AMD (1W: -9.63% | 1M: +10.68%) CORRECTION — bearish headlines but 1M strength creates divergence to monitor. META (-50): Equity raise/dilution headlines; META (1W: -6.25% | 1M: -3.24%) BELOW TREND — confirming downside pressure.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF with Defensive/Healthcare tilt. MDT, ABT, UNH (ALL ABOVE TREND) showing relative strength while major Tech names (NVDA, MSFT, GOOGL, META) are BELOW TREND or in CORRECTION. Key risk: major-cap divergence and negative Tech/AI headlines (INTU, AMD, META) that could prolong narrow market participation.
